# Shahan Ali (ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, proboy315)

> Shahan Ali, also known as ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315 and proboy315, is a full-stack developer, bot architect and Shopify expert from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He builds web applications, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, custom Shopify e-commerce, and AI integrations while studying ICS 1st Year at Govt Graduate College Burewala.

- Site: https://proboy.vercel.app
- Email: shahanali.dev@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +92 326 1684315

## Projects
- [ProBoy-MD](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-md): ProBoy-MD is a Node.js WhatsApp multi-device bot by Shahan Ali (ProBoy), built with Baileys. It uses command files for automation, media utilities, group tools and developer utilities.
- [ProBoy Connections](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-connections): ProBoy Connections is an analytics portal by Shahan Ali for watching active bot-node connections, regional distribution, hourly traffic and live connection logs.
- [ProBoy CamLink](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/camlink): ProBoy CamLink is a control panel by Shahan Ali for diagnostic shortlinks, device diagnostic logs and image-capture feeds, with a glass-style control interface.
- [ProBoy JS Obfuscator](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/js-obfuscator): ProBoy JS Obfuscator is a client-side tool by Shahan Ali for encoding and protecting JavaScript source files before production use.
- [ProBoy-MD Pairing Portal](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/md-pairing): The ProBoy-MD pairing portal is a web page by Shahan Ali that generates a multi-device pairing code for WhatsApp bots, so a session can be linked without scanning a QR code.
- [ProBoy-SiM Database](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/sim-database): ProBoy-SiM is a database portal by Shahan Ali for browsing structured simulation records and activation reports with table filtering.
- [Shopify Custom E-Commerce Engine](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/shopify-engine): A Shopify build by Shahan Ali that connects supplier inventory and fulfillment to an Online Store 2.0 storefront, with Liquid theme work aimed at fast page loads.
- [Social Creator Monetization Dashboard](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/creator-dashboard): A creator analytics dashboard by Shahan Ali for reading YouTube, TikTok and Facebook creator-fund style revenue, including RPM-style forecasts.

## Showcase demos
- [LuxeCart](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/luxecart): Concept storefront for a luxury watch house: Swiss tourbillon catalogue, cart, one-click checkout and a merchant admin.
- [DevMarket](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/devmarket): Concept marketplace for developer products: SaaS boilerplates, API starters, bots and UI kits, plus a seller admin.
- [BiteRush](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/biterush): Concept food-delivery app with item customization, order tracking and a restaurant admin.
- [AutoVault](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/autovault): Concept showroom for hypercars with specifications, a comparison matrix, test-drive booking and a dealer admin.
- [Nestora](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/nestora): Concept property site with search filters, a mortgage estimator and a broker admin.
- [FitForge](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/fitforge): Concept fitness product with calorie rings, workout streaks and a trainer admin.
- [Tripora](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/tripora): Concept expedition site with itineraries, a gallery, concierge booking and an agency admin.
- [SoundPulse](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/soundpulse): Concept shop for studio monitors and vinyl, with an equalizer-style interface and a merchant admin.
- [NeuralDesk](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/neuraldesk): Concept AI workspace with multi-agent prompts, document analysis and token analytics.
- [Learnova](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/learnova): Concept learning platform with video lessons, a curriculum, certificates and an instructor admin.
- [MediBook](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/medibook): Concept clinic booking flow with specialist search, time slots, confirmation states and a clinic admin.
- [Artivio](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/artivio): Concept auction house for fine art with live-bidding screens, one-of-one lots, collector suites and a curator admin.
- [HireFlow](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/hireflow): Concept hiring tool with match scores, candidate pipelines and one-click apply, plus a recruiter admin.
- [ShipTrack](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/shiptrack): Concept logistics dashboard for container status, ETAs and port logs, with a logistics admin.
- [Stayora](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/stayora): Concept hotel site for villas and penthouses with plunge-pool stays and a hotel admin.
- [Finova](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/finova): Concept finance dashboard for net worth, spending and savings goals, with a finance admin.
- [SecurePass](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/securepass): Concept password-vault interface with a generator screen and a security admin. A UI demo only.
- [CloudPanel](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/cloudpanel): Concept hosting panel with CPU and memory charts, a terminal-style panel and a container list.
- [ShopAdmin](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/shopadmin): Concept store admin for revenue, stock alerts, order statuses and fulfillment.
- [Vortex](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/vortex): Concept creative studio site built around canvas, shader and particle visuals, with a director admin.
- [ProHub](https://proboy.vercel.app/showcase/prohub): Concept freelancer marketplace with talent profiles, hourly hiring, escrow states and a platform admin.

## Interactive demos
- [LuxeCart](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/luxecart-store) — Premium e-commerce store: Product catalogue with live search, category filters, working cart, quantity controls and a validated checkout demonstration.
- [Pulse](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/pulse-dashboard) — SaaS analytics dashboard: Sidebar navigation, tabbed overview, interactive SVG charts, metric cards and a settings panel with toggles.
- [Ember Kitchen](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/ember-kitchen) — Restaurant website: Menu browsing by course, a reservation form with validation and confirmation, plus opening hours and contact details.
- [Haven](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/haven-properties) — Real estate listings: Property search with filters for type, bedrooms and price, expandable listing details and an agent enquiry form.
- [Northline](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/northline-agency) — Creative agency site: Services, selected work, a small team section and a project enquiry form with real validation and success feedback.
- [Synth Studio](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/synth-ai-studio) — AI tool interface: Prompt input, model and tone selectors, character counter and a deterministic sample response generator that runs entirely in the browser.
- [Forge Docs](https://proboy.vercel.app/demos/forge-docs) — Developer documentation: Documentation layout with sidebar navigation, in-page search across sections and copyable code examples.

## ProBoy-MD commands
ProBoy-MD v6.0.1 uses prefix ".". The supplied menu reported 531 commands; parsing the current repository found 224 command files across 9 categories.
- admin: 3 commands
- ai: 49 commands
- dev: 29 commands
- fun: 43 commands
- general: 25 commands
- group: 25 commands
- media: 12 commands
- textmaker: 19 commands
- utility: 19 commands
- Pairing website: https://proboy-md.gt.tc/
